_comment: Single source of truth for the inputs the PRISM thermal-status classifier may use. Training (prism_ml.models.train) and inference (prism_ml.models.inference) both build features through prism_ml.features.contract from this file. Changing anything here requires a new contract_version and retraining.

thermal_pixels_c.invalid_marker_note: Current firmware writes 0.0 for NaN/out-of-range pixels; exactly 0.0 is therefore treated as invalid.

water_level_pct.note: Operational only (drinking/misting water availability). Never a classifier input.

calibration_profile.note: Identifier of the sensor calibration (offset) profile active on the device. Models record the profiles present in their training data.

features.name: thi
features.definition: (1.8*T+32) - (0.55-0.0055*RH)*(1.8*T-26); formula as printed in Vermeer & Aarnink (2023), p.8, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7620726

features.name: thermal_top4_mean_c
features.definition: Mean of the 4 hottest pixels (less sensitive to a single noisy pixel than the maximum)

features.name: thermal_median_c
features.definition: Median of the 64 pixels (approximates scene/background level)

features.name: thermal_std_c
features.definition: Population standard deviation of the 64 pixels

excluded_features.name: core_body_temperature
excluded_features.reason: Not measured by PRISM. AMG8833 readings are apparent surface temperatures and are not interchangeable with core temperature.

excluded_features.name: water_level_pct
excluded_features.reason: Reflects tank level, not the pigs' thermal condition.

excluded_features.name: feed_intake / weight_change
excluded_features.reason: Not available at the time scale of a sensor reading and not linked to readings in the current Firestore schema.
